segment.description: The TENNESSEE reach of South Chickamauga Creek (HUC-8 06020001) per the catalog: the major Chattanooga-area waterway with greenway access, flowing from the Georgia state line through the Chattanooga urban area to the Nickajack Lake portion of the Tennessee River. The City of Chattanooga watershed flyer states the creek 'has its origins in Georgia eventually emptying into the Nickajack Lake portion of the Tennessee River in Chattanooga.' The Georgia upper-reach programs and stream facts do NOT transfer to this Tennessee reach. Distinct from North Chickamauga Creek (a different stocked gorge stream).
segment.boundaries: GA-TN state line (USGS 03567000 'South Chickamauga below GA-Tenn. state line'; West Chickamauga Creek joins at the line) through Chattanooga (USGS 03567500 and 03567700 on the TN reach) to the Tennessee River/Nickajack Lake confluence.

coldSource.notes: Elevation is the gauge altitude of USGS 03567500 (644.05 ft). No dam on the Tennessee reach and no spring influence documented; the creek drains the largest of Chattanooga's nine urban watersheds (31,415 acres incl. Friar and Mackey Branch sub-watersheds) and hosts the South Chickamauga Creek Greenway.

holdover.detail: No holdover record found; no trout program exists on the Tennessee reach, so no carryover question has been surveyed or reported by any acceptable source.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout presence documented for the Tennessee reach: zero hits for 'South Chickamauga' on TWRA's trout-regulations page (no wild-trout/special/DH listing) and zero stocking rows — TWRA's 2026 schedule contains only 'N. Chickamauga Creek' (Hamilton Co.), a different water. No fish-community survey naming trout was located for the TN reach.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: USGS grab samples on the Tennessee reach (03567500) repeatedly show August water of 27.0-28.5 degC, and neither TWRA's stocking schedule nor its trout-regulation lists carry any Tennessee-reach trout program.
